standard: EPA AQS hourly (wide); TCEQ continuous sonde table; NOAA CO-OPS 6-minute water level; USGS 15-minute stage and discharge
notes: Fixed environmental sensors at the positions in sensor_registry.json. All times UTC. Sensors drop out in the hurricane and return at different times; missing rows are gaps. No derived or explanatory columns: readings only.

coverage.cadence: air hourly; sondes 15 min; tide gauges 6 min; stream gauges 15 min

field_notes.Benzene_ppb: hourly mean; health reference used locally is 3 ppb
field_notes.TNMHC_ppbC: total non-methane hydrocarbons, ppb carbon (1 ppm = 1000 ppb)
field_notes.blank value: the monitor does not measure that parameter

field_notes.TotalHydrocarbons_ppb: total petroleum hydrocarbons, micrograms per litre (1000 ppb = 1 mg/L; agency alert level 0.10 mg/L = 100 ppb; surface-water standard 0.05 mg/L)
field_notes.Depth_m: water depth over the sensor; piling-mounted sondes follow tide and surge, moored buoys stay near 1 m
field_notes.QC: A accepted, S suspect (very high sediment load)

field_notes.WaterLevel_ft_MLLW: observed, feet above mean lower low water (1 m = 3.28084 ft)
